query.description: query selecting the entities this builder reads

model.description: model for this builder, overriding the host default

format.description: JSON graph outputs or one stored media artifact

floor.description: the earliest a schedule may build it again

immediate.description: build when query inputs change, without waiting for its floor

builder.description: runs its instruction (its doc body) on the inputs selected by its query

key.description: the input key last started in this variant

inputs.description: selected input ids offered to the session

prompt.description: the exact request sent to the model

build.description: the last session started for one variant of a builder

slot.description: stable name of this output within one build

key.description: the hash of the instruction, the model and each input's content hash it was built from

artifact.description: the media artifact this output names, when present

media_type.description: the artifact's media type, when present

built.description: one named output, updated in place across builds of its variant

builder_build.title: Build now
builder_build.description: Build a builder now, whatever its schedule says. Its query selects inputs; an unchanged key reuses the output, and a changed key updates that output in place. Passing an alternate provider, model or prompt builds a shadow output for comparison. Returns the output and session, or the current output.

builder.description: id of the builder to build

provider.description: the provider to ask instead of the configured one

model.description: the model to build with instead of the configured one

prompt.description: alternate instruction for a shadow build

builder_open.description: build a builder whose floor has passed, unless its key is built

builder_ring.description: a wake fired on a builder: check whether it is due

builder_answer.description: a build's session answered with graph outputs or a media artifact

builder_change.description: check immediate builders when an entity enters, changes or leaves their query
